title: Two coordinate 3-cycles cost twelve formal calls: exact search excludes length ≤ 11 (no new κ)
body:
## Result

In the formal model `M_2(F2[GL_3(F2)])` of #4939/#4950/#4968, a pair of coordinate 3-cycles `diag([c],[c])` has **no realizing word of length ≤ 11**. Two shortest 3-cycle words attain 12, so **the cost is exactly 12, and additive**: the two registers share no paid work.

This answers the smallest case of #4968's open question. #4974's support lemma settles single targets but only bounds the largest one. Permutation cuts cannot even certify a single 3-cycle; they reach about 3.5 of 6.

**No new κ.** The selected exponent stays `60403/20000000`. This is a negative formal-model screen.

## Method

`search.c` is an exact meet-in-the-middle search. Paid calls are involutions, and free scalars are normalized away (#4939 step 1).

- **Forward.** A depth-first search from `I` to depth ≤ 5 records 61-bit fingerprints: 16,292,362 distinct states.
- **Backward.** A depth-first search from `T` to depth ≤ 6 looks up every state. Fingerprints are deterministic, and the run records **zero key matches**, which excludes every word of length ≤ 11. Any match would have been re-verified by an exact forward re-search.
- **Symmetry.** The target and generator set are fixed by 36 algebra automorphisms (automorphisms of GL_3 fixing `c`, times `GL_2(F2)` register conjugation). They form a single orbit on the 36 generators.
- **Symmetry-free confirmation.** The search is repeated without the reduction, over all 36 first letters in parallel shards, again with zero key matches.

## Evidence

`verify.py` uses the standard library and C11. It takes about 75 s locally with 9 shards. It:

- compiles with `-Wall -Wextra -Werror`;
- binds the C engine to the merged Python `formal.py` on 84 random words by exact state comparison;
- reproduces the distinct-state counts 37 / 1,033 / 26,551 / 663,496;
- runs positive controls on `diag([c],[e])`, `diag([s01],[s12])` and `diag([s01],[s01])`: nothing at length ≤ 5, and 6 is found;
- checks the 12-call attaining word in Python;
- runs both main searches.

Breaking the generator product or perturbing the forward count makes it fail.

CI runners have fewer cores than my machine, so the symmetry-free shards take longer there. They are expected to fit the 600 s cap.

## Task and overlap

Card `bit-new-register-model`, scope **changed** (see `TASK.json`). Base: canonical main `f259dabc7d70e0db8d6d36bfda888f008bbfecc1`, priority revision 7. [CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19139334).

Only `n = 3`, `R = 2` is covered. A third dirty register, spectator coordinates and other multi-target cases remain open.

